# Synthetic Django audio export fixture

`audio_export.zip` was generated by the real Django `OfflinePackGenerator` through
`AudioExportContractTests.test_generated_archive_for_flutter_reader` on 2026-11-09.
It contains synthetic silence WAVs, a lesson/item and a quiz. It has no Beriya
teaching content, speaker recordings, personal data or production credentials.

The Flutter contract test installs this archive using the existing download
service and verifies local media resolution using fresh reader/service instances.
It does not assert perceptual playback quality or a physical Android restart.

To regenerate from the repository root in PowerShell (uses an in-memory database
and disposable media storage; SDK/test execution permissions may be required):

```powershell
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'
$env:BK_AUDIO_FIXTURE_DIR=(Join-Path (Get-Location) 'mobile/test/fixtures')
backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe docs/run_backend_checks.py offline_packs.tests_audio_export.AudioExportContractTests.test_generated_archive_for_flutter_reader
Remove-Item Env:BK_AUDIO_FIXTURE_DIR
```

Regenerate when intentionally changing the pack contract; review the archive
contents and rerun the Flutter test. UUIDs/timestamps/ZIP bytes may vary between
generations, so the test computes the checksum from the actual fixture bytes.
